devflow.description: The plugin version this configuration was written against. The router compares it with the running plugin's manifest version when /develop is typed, and manifest-alignment asserts it agrees with both manifests.

ticket.name: manifest-alignment
ticket.description: Both manifests agree on name, version, description and author, and the version stamp in this file agrees with them.

ticket.name: marketplace-source-path
ticket.description: Each marketplace entry's source path resolves to a directory that exists.

ticket.name: skill-discovery
ticket.description: Every skill the plugin ships sits where the default scan reaches it: no skills key in the plugin manifest, and every SKILL.md exactly one level under skills/. A skill placed anywhere else registers nowhere and reports nothing.

ticket.name: shipped-executables
ticket.description: Every file the plugin ships to be run is a non-empty regular file carrying the executable bit.

ticket.name: markdown-links
ticket.description: Every relative link in every tracked markdown file this repository owns resolves.

ticket.name: skill-conformance
ticket.description: The Agent Skills specification's Must rules over every skill directory in the subject. The plugin owns this file and the payload installer copies it here.

ticket.name: skill-hygiene
ticket.description: Skill references resolve and SKILL.md stays under 500 lines. The plugin owns this file and the payload installer copies it here.

ticket.name: adf-converter-tests
ticket.description: The markdown-to-ADF converter's behaviour, through the Node builtin test runner. The glob is quoted on purpose: the bare directory form fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND on the Node this repository runs.

ticket.name: payload-installer-tests
ticket.description: The payload installer's preflight, drift refusal and orphan reporting.

ticket.name: dependency-probe-tests
ticket.description: The dependency probe against fixture skill roots: the eleven required skills, the optional ones whose absence is not a fault, the two floor markers, the disable-model-invocation split in both directions, and the duplicate rule under the symlinked install layout the supported route produces.

ticket.name: issue-standards-tests
ticket.description: The issue-standards check over fixture artifact repositories: the five headings and their spelling, the section and link assertions, the ADF vocabulary, the summary rules, and the scope boundary it deliberately does not cross.
